title: Misuse

location.series: IBM Logo and Brand Guidelines for Third Parties / copyright 2022

slide_intent: Make source confusion visible through counterexamples, because problematic logo placement can be easier to recognize than a written prohibition.
strategic_value: Explicit rejected layouts can help external teams preserve the boundary between IBM participation and authorship.
demonstration: Four laptop mockups, crossed diagonally and captioned in red, show a combined identity, masthead/signature placement, entity-name use and a logo inserted into a sentence.
practical_value: Compare a proposed event page with these rejected patterns before publication.

content_islands.name: Reference guidance
content_islands.spec: Place the Misuse heading and links to the 8-bar and sub-brand guidance in the left column.

content_islands.name: Identity and masthead misuse
content_islands.spec: Show two crossed-out laptop layouts across the top of the right field.

content_islands.name: Naming and sentence misuse
content_islands.spec: Place two more rejected layouts below, retaining the red explanatory captions.

reference_purposes.Application: The four mockups translate abstract misuse rules into recognizable webpage arrangements.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Red captions explicitly prohibit identity incorporation, masthead/signature placement, use in an entity name and visual-logo insertion into a sentence.
